title: STAR answers without losing technical depth
summary: Use STAR as a narrative skeleton, then include architecture and decision evidence inside Action.

blocks.text: Use STAR as a narrative skeleton, then include architecture and decision evidence inside Action.

items: Situation: enough context to understand the constraint.
Task: your responsibility, not the whole team's.
Action: concrete design/debug/coordination decisions you made.
Result: measurable outcome or a specific lesson when measurement is unavailable.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
